title: Peñafrancia Basilica crossing

sources.title: OpenStreetMap: site and surrounding features
sources.note: ODbL. Site and building footprints, mapped monuments and facilities. No OSM edit dates are interpreted as construction dates.

sources.title: Independent facility reference
sources.note: Commons belfry record supports further tower research. Facade appearance was reviewed in Dominic McArthur's independent photograph; crossing and facade parts are schematic estimates. Forecourt fitted to Basilica Loop; grounds extent is estimated in OSM. Centennial Globe already mapped, not duplicated. All added positions, counts, widths and heights are schematic estimates fitted to OSM, not surveyed geometry. No satellite or Google Maps imagery was used. No timeline dates are inferred.

sources.title: Dominic McArthur: Peñafrancia Basilica Minore, 2014
sources.note: CC BY-SA 3.0. Independent frontage photograph shows the bell tower and spire beside the facade, paving, lawn, planting and mature trees. Tower, crossing and roof positions/sizes are schematic estimates fitted to OSM; no roof geometry is surveyed.
